name: James Scoggins
research_summary: Scoggins combines physics-based modeling and machine learning to predict extreme heating and gas-flow behavior during hypersonic flight. His work includes spacecraft and meteor entry, radiation, thermal-protection materials, and interpreting flight sensors under uncertainty.

quiz.question: Which data-based approach does Scoggins combine with physics models?
What temperature-related hazard does he study?
Name one object whose atmospheric entry he studies.
What materials help protect entry vehicles from heat?
Does his sensor work account for uncertainty?
choices: Yes, including uncertainty in flight sensors.
No, he ignores all sensor error.
quiz.answer: Yes, including uncertainty in flight sensors.
